name: Mallasindura

sections.overview:
Mallasindura- Ingredients, Indications, Preparation, Medicinal Properties, Dosage & More 
 Classical Reference : A.F.I. Part 1 – 15:3 (Siddhabhaisajya manimala Chapter 5, verse 37) 
 Abstract 
 Bronchial asthma epidemics are rising globally, driven by allergens, pollution, and eosinophilic inflammation, with Ayurveda offering holistic management through Vata-Kapha pacification and ama clearance. Tamaka Swasa (bronchial hyperreactivity) and Vata-Kaphaja disorders correlate with bronchial asthma’s Th2 cytokines, IgE responses, and elevated AEC, mimicking post-viral respiratory distress in tropical regions. Beyond bronchodilators, Ayurveda emphasizes lung oxygenation, constipation relief, and antimicrobial action against triggers like influenza. Mallasindura, a potent formulation, excels in resolving chronic asthma with its hot and piercing herbo-mineral synergy. Let’s explore this formulation.
sections.introduction:
Mallasindura, a potent classical Ayurvedic herbo-mineral formulation from Siddhabhaishajyamanimala, excels in bronchodilatory action for respiratory and cardiac channels. This Vata-Kapha-balancing formula harnesses purified mercury, sulphur, rasa karpura, and arsenic trioxide with lung-stimulating, anti-eosinophilic, antimicrobial, detoxifying, and rejuvenative effects. It masterfully resolves bronchial hyperreactivity (Tamaka Swasa), cough-dyspnea, constipation-linked triggers, Phiranga roga (syphilis), and Kapha distress by clearing toxin-mucus blockages, enhancing oxygenation, igniting cardiac-nerve vitality, and countering Th2-IgE inflammation through synergistic Kupipakva purification. 
 पवनकफौ हन्ति मल्लसिंदूरः ॥३७॥ (सिद्धभैषज्यमणिमाला, अध्याय 5, 37) 
 The portion of this phrase states that Mallasindura is effective in pacifying Vata and Kapha dosas and the diseases arising from them. 
 Classical Indication 
 Vata-kapaha dominant disorders particularly Bronchial Asthma.

sections.rasakarpura_mecrurial_compound_108_g:
Shuddha Gandhaka (Purified and processed Sulphur) – 66 g 
 Shuddha Malla (Purified Arsenic oxide) – 54 g 

 Ingredient Description 
 1. Purified Mercury (Shuddha Parada) 
 It clears Vata-Kapha in respiratory disorders and bronchial hyperreactivity by acting as a potent rejuvenative and bio-enhancer, improving bioavailability of co-ingredients while stimulating digestive fire. Its cohesive, dense, unctuous properties, with sweet post-digestive effect and neutral potency after purification, penetrate deep channels; mercuric sulfide nanoparticles provide neurostimulant, rejuvenative effects on lung nerves and cardiac function in bronchial asthma. 
 2. Mercurial compound (Rasakarpura) 
 It rapidly relieves dyspnea, eosinophilic inflammation, and Kapha obstruction by pacifying aggravated Vata-Kapha, acting as a sharp digestive and bronchodilator. Pungent taste, heating potency, and subtle-light properties dissolve toxin-mucus adhesions; volatile mercurial salts sublimate toxins, modulate IgE pathways, and boost lung oxygenation against allergic triggers like pollution. 
 3. Purified Sulphur (Shuddha Gandhaka) 
 It resolves chronic cough, syphilis-like infections, and infectious asthma by antimicrobial action against respiratory pathogens, balancing Kapha while stabilizing mercury toxicity. Sweet-astringent taste, heating potency, and unctuous-mobile properties purify blood tissue; organic sulfur compounds exhibit antifungal, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory effects, relieving sticky Kapha distress in post-viral syndromes. 
 4. Purified Arsenic oxide (Shuddha Malla) 
 It powerfully counters bronchial constriction, constipation-linked triggers, and Th2 cytokines by its sharp purgative and Kapha-toxin digestive effects. Bitter-astringent taste, heating potency, and dry-light properties break channel blockages, detoxified arsenic trioxide provides cytotoxic, immunostimulant actions on eosinophils, enhancing expiratory flow while combating syphilis-like infections in Vata-Kapha disorders. 
 Method Of Preparation 
 कुप्यां द्वयहं परिपचेत्… (सिद्धभैषज्यमणिमाला, अध्याय 5, 37) 
 Mallasindura is prepared via the classical Kupipakva Rasayana method. All ingredients first undergo individual Shodhana (purification). Purified mercury and purified sulphur are triturated into smooth, black, lustrous Kajjali (HgS), blended with Rasakarpura (mercurial compound) and fine Shuddha Malla (arsenic compound) powder. The mixture is charged into a sealed glass bottle (Kupi) within a Valuka Yantra. Heating progresses in three phases using controlled temperature – Manda (mild) evaporates volatiles, Madhyama (moderate) forms mercuric-sulfuric bonds and tikshna (intense) for 24–48 hours) sublimes the vermilion-red product to the bottle neck. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 1. Tamaka Swasa (Bronchial Asthma) 
 Administer Mallasindura (62.5-125 mg twice daily) with Shring bhasam (250 mg) and honey (5 ml) to stimulate lung nerves, relieve bronchial hyperreactivity, and clear Kapha obstruction through Ushna-Tikshna bronchodilatory and anti-eosinophilic actions. 
 2. Vata-Kaphaja Roga (Vata-Kapha Disorders) 
 Use Mallasindura (62.5-125 mg twice daily) with ginger juice (Ardraka svarasa, 5 ml) to pacify dual doshas, dissolve ama-mucus blockages, and rejuvenate nerves via Rasayana potency of Shuddha Parada and Malla. 
 3. Phiranga Roga (Syphilis) 
 Take Mallasindura (62.5-125 mg twice daily) with honey to combat infectious pathogens, purify Rakta dhatu, and resolve skin eruptions through antimicrobial arseno-mercurial synergy and Kapha-Ama pachana effects. 
 4. Chronic Cough And Dyspnea 
 Administer Mallasindura (62.5-125 mg twice daily) with warm ginger juice to liquefy sticky Kapha, enhance oxygenation, and expel respiratory toxins via purgative and heart-stimulating Hridya properties. 
 5. Pneumonia 
 Administer Mallasindura with honey to combat respiratory infection, liquefy Kapha exudates, and restore lung function through antimicrobial arseno-mercurial action and heating bronchodilatory potency. 
 6. Eosinophilic inflammation 
 Use Mallasindura with ginger juice to reduce airway eosinophils, pacify Th2-mediated hyperreactivity, and clear mucus via sharp Kapha-toxin digestive and anti-inflammatory nanoparticle effects. 
 7. Hemiplegia (Pakshaghata) 
 Take Mallasindura with warm water to rejuvenate neuromuscular tissues, relieve Vata paralysis, and improve motor function through rejuvenative nerve stimulation and cardiac circulation enhancement. 
 8. Rheumatism (Amavata) 
 Administer Mallasindura with ginger juice to dissolve joint toxin deposits, reduce inflammation, and ease stiffness via Vata-Kapha balancing purgative and digestive properties. 
 9. Gout 
 Use Mallasindura with honey to purify blood tissue, break uric acid crystals, and relieve swelling through sharp detoxification and mineral anti-inflammatory synergy. 
 10. Neuromuscular Weakness 
 Take Mallasindura with warm water to strengthen muscle-nerve junctions, boost vitality, and counter debility via potent rejuvenative and bio-enhancer mercury-sulfur matrix. 
 11. Joint Pain 
 Administer Mallasindura with ginger juice to penetrate deep channels, pacify Vata aggravation, and lubricate joints through unctuous cardiac actions and toxin-digestive potency. 
 12. Indigestion 
 Use Mallasindura with honey to ignite digestive fire, dispel bloating, and improve assimilation via sharp digestive effects of purified sulfur and mercurial compounds. 
 13. Constipation 
 Take Mallasindura with warm water to relieve toxin constipation, promote purgation, and clear rectal blockages through sharp laxative and Vata-balancing properties. 
 14. Slow Heart Rate 
 Administer Mallasindura with ginger juice to stimulate cardiac function, enhance output, and regularize pulse via neurotonic and circulatory rejuvenative actions. 
 15. Weak Memory 
 Use Mallasindura with honey to sharpen intellect, rejuvenate brain tissues, and boost cognitive vitality through mercury-based rejuvenative and nerve-nourishing potency. 
 16. Schizophrenia-Like Symptoms 
 Take Mallasindura with warm water to balance mental doshas, calm neural hyperactivity, and stabilize mood via tranquilizing mineral synergy and Vata pacification. 
 17. Skin Eruptions (Eczema, Fungal) 
 Administer Mallasindura orally or as topical paste with honey to purify skin tissue, combat pathogens, and heal lesions through antifungal blood purification and antimicrobial effects. 
 18. Influenza Fevers 
 Use Mallasindura with ginger juice to resolve viral fevers, relieve respiratory distress, and boost immunity via antiviral herbo-mineral actions and Kapha-Vata balancing potency. 
 Impact On Dosha 
 Mallasindura predominantly balances Vata and Kapha doshas.

sections.dosage:
62.5-125 mg 
 Anupana (Adjuvant) 
 Honey, Ginger juice. 
 Contraindication 

 Liver/kidney impairment. 
 Pregnancy and lactation 
 Children: Avoid those under 8 years. 
 Overdosage: Exceeding 125 mg/dose risks Pitta aggravation (heartburn, rashes, agitation). 
 Self-medication prohibited—use only under Rasashastra expert. 

 Conclusion 
 Mallasindura emerges as a time-tested Kupipakva Rasayana that masterfully bridges classical Ayurveda with modern respiratory challenges. Its synergistic herbo-mineral matrix purified mercury, sulphur, and arsenic trioxide delivers heating-sharp potency to pacify Vata-Kapha, dissolve eosinophilic toxins, stimulate bronchodilation, and enhance cardiac-lung vitality in bronchial asthma and related disorders. While potent against bronchial hyperreactivity, syphilis-like infections, and post-viral debility, its safe efficacy hinges on meticulous purification, precise dosing, and expert oversight to avert contraindications.
